title: generator's result
description: What the generator writes as it ends, at <round>/generator.json: its result, the files it wrote, and what it found good as it tried the deliverable as its people would.

result.description: The word it gives as it ends: made, once the deliverable is made and tried; point, where a point that only the user can settle stops it.

point.description: With point: the point, with the generator's recommendation and its ground, which the orchestrator puts to the user as given.

files.description: With made: each file it wrote, from the run's worktree.

good.description: With made: each condition that it saw the deliverable meet as it tried it as its people would, with the lines that meet it.

condition.description: The condition's ID in the best practice, such as N2.

lines.description: Each line of the deliverable that meets it, word for word as it stands, so that a reader checks the answer by reading them.
